groups.canonical_citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, Feb. 2017)
groups.conflict_note: This is a city policy applicable only to subsidized/income-restricted or DND-funded housing providers, not to general market-rate multifamily buildings; state/federal screening law provides broader but less detailed protections.
groups.interaction: Applies only to DND-funded/income-restricted housing; broader market-rate screening is governed by state anti-discrimination law.

groups.canonical_citation: Boston Fair Housing Regulations - Source of Income Protection
groups.interaction: Complements the state source-of-income/public-assistance discrimination protection under M.G.L. c.151B §4(10).

groups.canonical_citation: Boston Ordinance Sec. 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
groups.interaction: Imposes notice and city-reporting requirements that apply in addition to the state notice-to-quit requirement under M.G.L. c.186 §11.
